_spec: PRE-REGISTERED positive/negative control for cross-domain analogy.
_frozen: 2026-08-15, before any control corpus was ingested and before any score was observed.
_contract: This file is NEVER ingested and never reaches an extractor. It is read only by the oracles.
The two corpora are ingested INDEPENDENTLY and neither may contain material that states or implies the correspondence. Torin must discover it.
Expected mappings were chosen from the standard electrical/hydraulic analogy in engineering, not from anything Torin produced.
Do not edit expected_mappings or negative_mappings after observing results. Adding a mapping because the system found it converts the control into a description of the output.

expected_mappings.structural_role: the potential difference that drives transport
the quantity transported per unit time
what opposes transport and dissipates energy
what stores the transported quantity and releases it later

expected_relational_structure.note: surface relation labels will differ; the oracle records BOTH the raw label match and the (currently unavailable) relation-class match

negative_mappings.why: a potential is not a store
flow is not potential; this is the classic inversion
an impediment is not the thing impeded

unrelated_domain_control.why: structured (morphemes compose words, affixes attach to stems) but with no expected correspondence to electrical circuits
unrelated_domain_control.expected_result: no mapping should score in the positive range

queries: electrical circuit voltage current resistance ohm law
hydraulic system pressure flow rate pipe restriction

corpus_specification.contamination_rule: Any ingested source whose text contains a forbidden term for its domain is EXCLUDED and reported. A corpus that teaches the analogy invalidates the control.

success_criteria.primary: Locate the first boundary at which known structural correspondence disappears. Recovering all four mappings is NOT required for the experiment to be informative.
success_criteria.oracle_b: separation between the positive-control score distribution and the negative-control distribution, reported independently of any threshold
